newsitem.title: USA: Motorola wins $34 million cellular contract in India.
newsitem.headline: Motorola wins $34 million cellular contract in India.

text.p: Motorola Inc. said Wednesday its international cellular infrastructure unit won a contract worth $34 million to install a digital cellular telephone network in Punjab, India.
The award brings to $200 million the total value of contracts awarded to date to Motorola in India.
The contract is from Evergrowth Telecom Ltd., which was formed by J.T. Mobiles Ltd. to operate a cellular network in Punjab.

Motorola's networks will provide service for more than 50 percent of India's cellular subscribers. Initially, more than 100,000 subscribers in Punjab's key cities will be served by the Motorola Global System for Mobile Communications service network.
